A '''Mining Outpost''' was a settlement on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], when they began occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Mining Outpost appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
